patient_name_source.text:
The patient has had abdominal pain associated with a 30-pound weight loss and then
developed jaundice. He had epigastric pain and was admitted to the hospital. A thin-slice CT
scan was performed, which revealed a pancreatic mass with involved lymph nodes and ring
enhancing lesions consistent with liver metastases.

primary_diagnosis_source.text: DISCHARGE SUMMARY - Pancreatic Mass - Discharge Summary

secondary_diagnoses: ring enhancing lesions consistent with liver metastases
questionable pseudocyst in the tail of the pancreas
procedures_performed: ERCP on 04/04/2007 with placement of a stent
placement of a 10-french x 9 cm stent with good drainage

diagnosis_explanation:
Your pancreas is an organ behind your stomach. A mass was found in your pancreas. This is a growth.

Your doctors also found swollen lymph nodes. These are small glands in your body. Sometimes they swell when there is a problem.

There are also spots in your liver. These spots look like they may have spread from the mass. This is called cancer that has spread.

A fluid pocket was seen in your pancreas. It is called a pseudocyst. It might be related to the pancreas mass.

The tubes inside your pancreas and liver are tight. These tubes carry important fluids. The tightness can cause problems.

You also have diabetes. This means your body has trouble using sugar for energy. This can affect your whole body.

You have high blood pressure. This means the pressure in your blood vessels is too high. This is also called hypertension.
medication_rationale:
Phenergan 25 mg q.6. as needed:
This medicine helps you feel less sick to your stomach. It can also help you feel sleepy. This is normal and shows the medicine is working. Call your doctor if you have trouble breathing or feel very confused.

Duragesic patch 100 mcg q.3.d.:
This medicine is a strong pain reliever. It is used to help manage your pain. You may feel sleepy or have a slower breathing rate. This is expected. Call your doctor if you have trouble breathing, feel very dizzy, or become confused.

Benadryl 25-50 mg by mouth four times daily:
This medicine is for your itchy skin. It can help relieve the itching. You may feel sleepy. This is a common side effect. Call your doctor if your itching gets worse or if you have a rash.

Insulin Sliding Scale - stopping:
Your doctor wants you to stop taking this medicine. Your high blood sugar will be managed at another facility. Do not take it until your doctor tells you it is safe to start again.

Enalapril - stopping:
Your doctor wants you to stop taking this medicine. Your high blood pressure will be managed by another doctor. Do not take it until your doctor tells you it is safe to start again.
escalation_guide:
CALL 911 IMMEDIATELY
These symptoms are life-threatening. Do not drive yourself.
- Fever over 101 degrees: This may mean a bad infection.
- Yellow skin or eyes: Your liver may not work.
- Severe pain getting worse: This could mean a serious problem.

GO TO THE ER TODAY
Do not wait until tomorrow. Go within a few hours.
- Bilirubin level is high: This can harm your liver.
- Pain is getting worse: It may need stronger help.

CALL YOUR DOCTOR
Call during office hours. Do not go to the ER for these.
- Fever below 101 degrees: Check in with your doctor.
- Questions about your medicine: Call the office for help.
- Pain is not getting worse: Your doctor can help manage it.

missed_concepts.question: It says to call Dr. X for fever or worsening pain. How high does fever need to be or how bad does pain get before I call 911?
missed_concepts.gap_summary: Clear red flags for emergency care are not defined.

missed_concepts.question: What does it mean to have a pancreatic mass and how did it make me sick enough to come to the hospital?
missed_concepts.gap_summary: Diagnosis meaning and reason for admission unclear.

missed_concepts.question: The paper says I have a strictured pancreatic duct and bile duct. What does that mean for me?
missed_concepts.gap_summary: Understanding of duct strictures and their impact is missing.

missed_concepts.question: The paper lists Benadryl and Phenergan. When should I take them and what if I forget a dose?
missed_concepts.gap_summary: Dosing and missed dose instructions for Benadryl and Phenergan are missing.

missed_concepts.question: It says I need to see Dr. X for diabetes and hypertension. Who is Dr. X and how do I make those appointments?
missed_concepts.gap_summary: Clear instructions for booking follow-up appointments are missing.

missed_concepts.question: What foods should I avoid since I have diabetes and high blood pressure? The paper says regular diet.
missed_concepts.gap_summary: Specific diet advice for diabetes and hypertension is missing.

patient_simulator.simulator_summary: This patient has many serious diagnoses. The biggest gap is emergency warning signs. Going home without this is very risky.
